codes.label: Bug report
codes.definition: The message reports a broken or incorrect behavior in the product.
include_examples: The app crashes when I open the dashboard.
exclude_examples: Please add a CSV export button.

codes.label: Feature request
codes.definition: The message asks for a product capability that does not exist yet.
include_examples: Please add a CSV export button.

codes.label: Billing question
codes.definition: The message asks about an invoice, payment or charge.
include_examples: My invoice lists the wrong amount.
